mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level (indicating tighter monetary policy) increases equity discount rates, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d SPX returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that accelerates inflation and triggers monetary policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts and real consumption expenditures signals robust economic expansion that fuels inflation expectations, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for interaction condition <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production signals deteriorating economic momentum, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening that immediately increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp, or Rank IC >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate indicates weaker labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating payroll growth and housing starts signal rapid economic expansion that fuels inflation expectations, triggering monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% and HOUST monthly change > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST monthly changes exceed 0.5%, or Rank IC for interaction condition >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 (2017=100 index base) signals an industrial contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
